title: Wiki module settings
description: Operator settings of the wiki module. Passwords are never settings: they live in the module's Secrets.

wiki_title.description: Title shown in the wiki header.

x-can.not_applied: it is configured inside the application, and can-core does not write it

public_help_centre.description: Make the `help` namespace readable without logging in. Everything else stays private.

x-can.not_applied: it is configured inside the application, and can-core does not write it; the help namespace stays private until its access list is set there

php_memory_limit.description: PHP memory limit of the wiki (default 128M).

x-can.not_applied: it is configured inside the application, and can-core does not write it
